items.summary: MIGraphX ONNX parser does not resolve operators registered with register_experimental_custom_op (parse_onnx: 'Unknown operator: <op_type>'; register_op_parser is not exported), so TensorRT-style plugin libraries cannot supply ONNX ops; feature request for a fallback to a registered custom op of the same name. Blocks autoware_universe stage 3's plugin route.

decided.note: 2026-11-24: belongs to autoware_universe stage 3 (MIGraphX custom ops)

items.summary: MIGraphX f0239c965 parses ReduceSum over a zero-length axis ([0,4] -> [4]) but compile fails: 'benchmark: No valid tuned compilation for fused_reduce' with lens {0, 4}; TensorRT returns zeros. Also BROADCAST refuses an output size 0 when parsing a conv model with batch 0.
